Author: divinepleroma (based on OpenerCreator by Infi, herulume, sevii)
Name: Rehearsal
Punchline: Practise your opener: a small live timeline on your HUD that follows what you press.
Description:
Puts your opener on your HUD as a small strip that scrolls along as you play: the action to press next is ringed and shows the key it is bound to on your own hotbars, a wrong press or a skipped weave is marked the moment it happens, and one and two minute cooldowns are badged. Nothing to start or stop - press the first action and the attempt begins. A full two-lane panel with GCD numbers and times is there when you want to study the plan, and the whole thing minimizes to a tab or hides with one click.

A short setup walks you through the choices on first start. Bundled openers are the ones published by The Balance; you can build and save your own. It only watches your own actions: it never presses anything and sends nothing anywhere.

Based on OpenerCreator.
Changelog: First release as Rehearsal. The small strip is the default view, a five-step setup opens on first start, and the timeline can be minimized to a tab or hidden from the HUD.
